caseName: Ordway v. Region 13 Mental Health-Mental Retardation Commission
caseNameFull: Ordway v. Region 13 Mental Health-Mental Retardation Commission, dba Gulf Coast Mental Health Center

opinions.text: C. A. 5th Cir. Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied. Petitioner is allowed until February 6, 1984, within which to pay the docketing fee required by Rule 45(a) and to submit a petition in compliance with Rule 33 of the Rules of this Court.

opinions.author: Brennanmarshallblackmunstevens
opinions.text:
Justice Brennan, Justice Marshall, Justice Blackmun, and Justice Stevens,

dissenting.

For the reasons expressed in Brown v. Herald Co., ante, p. 928, we would deny the petition for certiorari in this case *1068without reaching the merits of the motion to proceed in forma pawperis.
